metadata.name: MiniMax-Speech-2.8
metadata.variant_policy: Hosted Speech 2.8 service announced January 23, 2026. Official announcement links the Open Platform and Audio product; no model checkpoint or self-hosted architecture is disclosed there. This record covers those public capabilities, not an open-weight release.

architecture.conditioning: Text includes native sound tags for fillers and nonverbal cues. Vendor describes voice cloning from a 10-second reference sample. Reference audio is conditioning for voice identity, not a claim of unrestricted audio-to-audio generation.
architecture.implementation: Hosted Open Platform API and MiniMax Audio are the access routes named in the announcement.

release.hosted_scope: Speech 2.8 text-to-speech with native sound tags, voice cloning and cross-lingual improvements is offered through Open Platform and MiniMax Audio.
limitations: Announcement provides capabilities and demos rather than architecture, weights, training details or output-format specifications.
Voice similarity and noise-removal improvements are vendor claims; no runtime or listening evaluation was performed here.

open_questions: Backbone, parameters, training objective/data/optimizer, codec and deployment precision are undisclosed in the registered announcement.
Sample rate, channels, output formats and request limits need version-specific API evidence before they can be filled.
Earlier Speech 02 /2.5 /2.6 services remain inventory items; the open Speech test dataset is not a release of model weights.
